title: EXP-092 - Hello World Part 5 Section 13: FX_Item Runtime Test on FX_Orders (Detail Combobox and Grid Column), Unsaved and Discarded
objective: Follow hello-world-pt5.md Section 13 (19:24-20:21), adapted to FX_ names and User scope: verify at runtime that the FX_Item component class applied in EXP-091 fills Item Description and Cost immediately, before any Save, in both the detail combobox (FX_ItemCombobox) and the grid column (FX_ItemGridCol). In the Web Client, after one runtime close/reopen and one blank-criteria query, on order 1: Customer ID FX001, Customer Name Factory test one, Address 1 Factory Street, Item dumbbell, Item Description 45 pound iron, Cost 45.00, Count 2, Order Total 90.00, choose eggs once from the Item drop-down in the detail view and verify Item Description cage free and Cost 6.99 immediately. Never save: discard by closing and answering No, reopen and verify both orders. Then, in a second separate cycle, choose eggs once in the order 1 grid row Item cell (widening the grid with at most one splitter drag if the Item column is not reachable), verify the grid row shows cage free and 6.99, discard the same way and verify both orders. The Designer is read-only. Findings are observed only.

in_scope: Before browser interaction read AGENTS.md, docs/mongoose/transcripts/hello-world-pt5.md Section 13 and its transcript lines (19:24-20:21), recipes/components/apply-component-class.md (the runtime steps and pitfalls) and recipes/session/session-expiry-and-stale-designer.md, and only the final Outcome (operator) sections of the EXP-089, EXP-090 and EXP-091 records. Do not read those records in full.
Create or update only experiments/EXP-092-hello-world-part-5-section-13-fx-item-runtime-test.md and evidence/EXP-092/ documentation and evidence files.
Record the worker-written-file inventory and a cumulative browser action audit with exact counts.

Use the existing authenticated session without refresh, restart or configuration change. If it expires, follow the worker-preamble session-expiry procedure once and end the task; never sign in inside the portal's embedded app frame (refused, EXP-080-R2) but use the procedure's top-level portal navigation. List the browser tabs before the first tab selection. Answer any prompt within the same task; never leave a prompt, menu or unsaved runtime change open across tasks. After any pause, inspect the state read-only before acting and never replay an earlier action.

Designer gate (read-only, no dialogs): the Designer is in User scope and clean on FX_Orders (open it once through the Form menu recent-forms entry if needed); in the Details > Components grid record the Component Class column for FX_ItemCombobox and FX_ItemGridCol (expected FX_Item on both). If either differs, record it and stop blocked.

Runtime baseline (read-only): in the Web Client, if FX_Orders is open close it once (clean); open it once through Form > Open > Select Form, record the mode, switch to Filter in Place if needed, leave every criterion blank and press F4 once; verify order 1: Customer ID FX001, Customer Name Factory test one, Address 1 Factory Street, Item dumbbell, Item Description 45 pound iron, Cost 45.00, Count 2, Order Total 90.00 and order 2: Customer ID FX002, Customer Name Factory test two, Address 2 Factory Street, Item eggs, Item Description cage free, Cost 6.99, Count 1, Order Total 6.99 (move between orders only by clicking their row-number cells). Record which grid columns are visible and whether the order 1 grid row Item cell is reachable without changing the layout. Do not open any drop-down in the baseline.

Detail check: on order 1, open the detail-view Item drop-down once, record its columns and rows with a screenshot, and choose eggs once from the list (never type). Without any Save, record Item, Item Description, Cost, Count and Order Total in the detail view and the order 1 grid row, with a screenshot. Expected: Item Description cage free and Cost 6.99 immediately; Order Total is recorded as observed only.

Discard 1: close the runtime FX_Orders Form once; answer No once to the prompt to save changes and record its exact text; if any other prompt appears (for example about grid or splitter layout changes) answer No once and record its exact text; if no save prompt appears, record it and stop blocked for the coordinator without further action. Then reopen FX_Orders once through Form > Open > Select Form (blank criteria, F4 once; move between orders only by clicking their row-number cells) and verify order 1: Customer ID FX001, Customer Name Factory test one, Address 1 Factory Street, Item dumbbell, Item Description 45 pound iron, Cost 45.00, Count 2, Order Total 90.00 and order 2: Customer ID FX002, Customer Name Factory test two, Address 2 Factory Street, Item eggs, Item Description cage free, Cost 6.99, Count 1, Order Total 6.99 unchanged.

Cache contingency, only if after the detail choice neither Item Description nor Cost changed: after Discard 1, close the clean runtime Form, invoke the Web Client Form > Definition > Unload All Global Form Objects once (no runtime Form dirty), reopen FX_Orders once (F4 once), choose eggs once more in the detail view on order 1, record the result, and discard once more as in Discard 1. If used, skip the grid check and stop for the coordinator. Never use the Designer unload.

Grid check, on the reopened Form with order 1 selected: if the order 1 grid row Item cell is not reachable, widen the grid once by dragging the splitter between the grid and the detail view (record the layout before and after with screenshots); then click the order 1 grid row Item cell once, open its drop-down once, record its columns and rows, and choose eggs once (never type). Without any Save, record the order 1 grid row Item, Item Description, Cost, Count and Order Total and the detail view values, with a screenshot. Expected: grid row Item Description cage free and Cost 6.99 immediately.

Discard 2: close the runtime FX_Orders Form once; answer No once to the prompt to save changes and record its exact text; if any other prompt appears (for example about grid or splitter layout changes) answer No once and record its exact text; if no save prompt appears, record it and stop blocked for the coordinator without further action. Then reopen FX_Orders once through Form > Open > Select Form (blank criteria, F4 once; move between orders only by clicking their row-number cells) and verify order 1: Customer ID FX001, Customer Name Factory test one, Address 1 Factory Street, Item dumbbell, Item Description 45 pound iron, Cost 45.00, Count 2, Order Total 90.00 and order 2: Customer ID FX002, Customer Name Factory test two, Address 2 Factory Street, Item eggs, Item Description cage free, Cost 6.99, Count 1, Order Total 6.99 unchanged; record whether the widened grid layout persisted.
Close the runtime FX_Orders Form once at the end (clean).

Capture screenshots of the Designer gate, the runtime baseline, both drop-down lists, the detail view after the detail choice, the grid row after the grid choice, the splitter layout before and after (if dragged), each prompt before answering, and the reopened orders after each discard.
Record any blocker after at most one fresh untargeted snapshot and one corrected visible inspection. Classify findings as observed only.

acceptance_checks.description: Sources reviewed; session usable; Designer FX_Orders in User scope and clean with Component Class FX_Item on FX_ItemCombobox and FX_ItemGridCol; runtime baseline shows order 1: Customer ID FX001, Customer Name Factory test one, Address 1 Factory Street, Item dumbbell, Item Description 45 pound iron, Cost 45.00, Count 2, Order Total 90.00 and order 2: Customer ID FX002, Customer Name Factory test two, Address 2 Factory Street, Item eggs, Item Description cage free, Cost 6.99, Count 1, Order Total 6.99; grid column visibility recorded. Evidence: Designer gate and baseline screenshots.

Choosing eggs once from the detail-view Item drop-down on order 1 changes Item Description to cage free and Cost to 6.99 before any Save; drop-down columns and Order Total recorded; the contingency unload used at most once and only under its condition. Discard 1: one close with No (exact prompt text recorded) and the reopen shows both orders unchanged. Evidence: drop-down, post-choice, prompt and reopened-order screenshots.

Grid check: at most one splitter drag (layout before/after recorded); choosing eggs once in the order 1 grid row Item cell shows Item Description cage free and Cost 6.99 in that row before any Save. Discard 2: one close with No (and No to any layout prompt, text recorded); the reopen shows both orders unchanged and records whether the layout persisted. Evidence: splitter, grid drop-down, post-choice, prompt and reopened-order screenshots.
No Designer change, no runtime Save, no Yes answer, no typed runtime value, no other grid cell or column change; the runtime Form closed clean at the end.

The final EXP-092 report gives decisive evidence for AC-1 to AC-4, the complete action audit with exact counts (runtime opens and closes, F4 count, drop-down opens, eggs choices, splitter drags, prompts answered No with texts, runtime Saves 0, Designer Saves 0, unloads, checkout actions 0, re-login count), the worker-written-file inventory and the final state. Repository confinement is supported by worker/harness inventories, with operator git review authoritative. Findings are observed only.
